body:
Allow ADR number assignment when an inherited numbered record has an appended amendment. The original path, mode and complete byte prefix must survive; assignment preserves the amended product blob. Rewrites, truncation, removal, relocation, mode changes, oversized changed blobs and altered reports still refuse. This unblocks the required historical ADR amendments in #1676 without granting semantic approval to them.

Hypomnema advances to 5.11.0 with its held frontier unchanged; Hexaemeron packages the change as 1.6.43.

Validation: 72 focused tests pass, including plan/apply/replay preservation, rejection of rewritten history, a real signed Fiat composition and refusal of its unsigned counterpart. The original reproduction also passes. The staged commit gate passed all 2,017 tests. Checks against the committed changes are running; their final result will be recorded in a follow-up comment.

Closes #1684.

title: Preserve appended ADR amendments during number assignment
